title: Edmund and the Room
author: Sebastian Thornbury
blurb: Dominic Whitlock, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
